**Outcome: nothing moved to Router.** Every real production LLM call site in this repo hits a reason Router can't (or shouldn't) serve:

The other 41 worklist hotspots were dispatch literals, UI dropdown choices, dict mappings, and type-only `anthropic` imports (used for callback typing, never instantiated) — none of those are themselves calls, so they're claimed `not_a_site` with evidence pointing at the real call sites above.

No files were edited beyond what the floor already touched — this repo's actual LLM traffic (Anthropic computer-use beta, a self-hosted UI-TARS/SSH model, DashScope) structurally can't route through Router today, so the correct migration here is "leave it on the provider with evidence," not code changes.
